name: Corpus Source Provenance Policy
purpose: Make every corpus record traceable to a source without treating a catalogue entry as verified text.
rules: Never promote pending material to verified fact through search ranking.
Preserve the original source identity and edition metadata when available.
Keep copyrighted text out of the repository unless reuse rights are established.
Catalogue records may describe a work without containing its full text.
Prefer primary or officially attributed sources when available.
Conflicting scholarly positions remain separately attributable records.
pending_verification is a non-trusted state used by corpus ingestion until source verification is completed.
